Keep pushing through, or look at the pattern underneath?

For corporate professionals, executives, leaders, business owners, and anyone facing a career pivot, a reinvention, or ageism.

You can prepare for the meeting, know the business case, or see the career move clearly. Then the same mental block shows up and you handle it the way you always have. One-to-one coaching with Terry Yoffe pairs practical strategy with mindset work to get at the pattern behind it.

The cost of the pattern you keep working around

You have real experience to draw on. That is what makes the block so frustrating. You can know exactly what needs to happen in a leadership conversation or a business decision, and still respond from the same old place.

So the pattern keeps its place. It shapes how you lead, how you communicate, and how quickly you second-guess a choice you were sure about last week.

Strategy and mindset, one to one

Terry's coaching blends strategy with mindset mastery. The strategy side deals with the decision in front of you: the leadership challenge, the business call, the career move. The mindset side asks what has been driving your usual response.

That means uncovering the mental block and shifting a long-standing pattern, rather than adding another tactic on top of it. Terry draws on her life experience and intuitive coaching mastery, and the work stays one to one, built around your situation.

Meet Terry Yoffe

Terry Yoffe is a 3X Certified International Business and Communications Coach with over 20 years of professional coaching experience and 60 years of life, business and leadership wisdom.

Her credentials include PCC accreditation with the ICF and CPCC certification with CTI. She served as president of the ICF New York City Chapter and holds Master and Post-Master NLP certifications.

Her background includes director-level publishing roles at Condé Nast, The New Yorker, Bon Appétit and Women's Wear Daily. She founded Terry Yoffe Enterprises and TRY Coaching. She has worked inside large organizations and built her own, which is the context she brings to conversations with professionals, leaders and owners.

Can coaching shift a pattern you have carried for years?

That is a fair question, especially if you have tried to think your way out of it before. Terry's work is built around mental blocks and long-standing patterns, so the pattern is the subject, not a side issue.

It is also practical. The pattern shows up in specific moments: a leadership conversation, a business decision, a career move. The coaching connects the two, using strategy for the situation and mindset work for what drives your response.

Terry has over 20 years of coaching experience, and the work is one to one. The free consultation is the place to decide whether her approach fits what you are facing.
